_comment: English translations. The server translates JSON responses at the boundary (hu.sporolos.i18n.Translator): recipes by id (name, steps), ingredients by key, 'phrases' and 'words' by exact text (words: lower-case parts of comma-separated spice lists), 'units' singular/plural for amounts, 'patterns' = ordered regex replacements for generated sentences (deal reasons, notes, amounts). Missing entries fall back to Hungarian.

paprikas-csirke.name: Chicken paprikash with nokedli dumplings
steps: Finely chop the onion and fry it in oil until translucent, take it off the heat and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the chicken legs, the diced pepper and tomato, season with salt and braise covered with a little water for about 40 minutes.
For the nokedli, mix the flour with the eggs, salt and enough water to make a thick dumpling batter, then drop small pieces into boiling salted water.
Stir the sour cream smooth with a spoonful of flour, add it to the sauce and simmer for another 2–3 minutes.

bolognai.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and grated carrot in oil.
Add the minced meat and brown it, then pour in the passata, season and cook for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Serve the sauce piled on the pasta, sprinkled with grated cheese.

rakott-krumpli.name: Hungarian potato bake
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins and hard-boil the eggs, then peel and slice both.
Layer them in a buttered baking dish: potato, egg, sausage, sour cream – finish with potato and sour cream on top.
Bake in a 200 °C oven for about 35–40 minutes until golden brown.

lecso.name: Lecsó (pepper and tomato stew) with sausage
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the sliced sausage.
Add the pepper cut into strips, after 10 minutes the diced tomato, and season with salt.
When the vegetables are soft, crack in the eggs and stir until they set. Serve with fresh bread.

rantott-csirke.name: Breaded chicken breast with parsley potatoes
steps: Slice the chicken breast, pound it thin and season with salt.
Coat in flour, beaten egg and then breadcrumbs, and deep-fry in plenty of oil.
Boil the potatoes in salted water and toss them with butter and parsley.

csirkes-curry.name: Coconut chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice in twice its volume of salted water until tender.
Fry the onion and garlic, add the diced chicken and 2 tablespoons of curry powder.
Add the pepper strips and the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

chili-con-carne.name: Chili con carne
steps: Brown the minced meat with the onion and season with chili and ground cumin.
Pour in the passata, add the drained beans and sweetcorn and cook for 25 minutes.
Serve with boiled rice or bread.

tortilla.name: Chicken tortilla wraps
steps: Cut the chicken into strips, season and cook through in a frying pan.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and spread them with sour cream.
Fill with the chicken, sweetcorn, vegetables and grated cheese, and roll up tightly.

rantotta.name: Scrambled eggs with peppers and tomato
steps: Dice the pepper and tomato and soften them in butter for 3 minutes.
Pour over the beaten, salted eggs and stir over a low heat until creamy. Serve with toast.

palacsinta.name: Jam and cottage cheese crêpes
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, a pinch of salt and a little oil until smooth, and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Fry thin crêpes in a hot frying pan.
Mix the cottage cheese with sugar and lemon zest; fill half of the crêpes with jam and half with the cottage cheese.

turos-csusza.name: Pasta with cottage cheese and crispy bacon
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Dice the bacon and fry it until crispy.
Toss the pasta with the rendered fat and top with cottage cheese, sour cream and the crispy bacon.

lencsefozelek.name: Lentil stew with frankfurters
steps: Cook the soaked lentils with a bay leaf until tender.
Sauté the onion in oil, sprinkle with flour to make a roux and add it to the lentils.
Season with vinegar and salt and loosen with sour cream. Serve with boiled frankfurters.

zoldborsofozelek.name: Green pea stew with meatballs
steps: Knead the minced meat with the soaked bread roll, egg, grated onion and spices, shape patties and fry them.
Sweat the peas in a little fat with a pinch of sugar, then cook until tender with a little water.
Thicken with milk mixed with flour and season with parsley.

spenotfozelek.name: Creamed spinach with fried eggs
steps: Thaw the spinach with garlic and bring it to the boil.
Thicken with milk mixed with flour and season with salt.
Serve with fried eggs and potatoes boiled in salted water.

gombapaprikas.name: Mushroom paprikash with dumplings
steps: Sauté the onion, sprinkle with paprika, add the sliced mushrooms and braise them in their own juice until tender.
Thicken with sour cream.
Meanwhile make small dumplings from flour, egg and water.

kaposztas-teszta.name: Cabbage pasta
steps: Grate the cabbage, salt it and squeeze it out after 10 minutes.
Caramelise the sugar in oil, add the cabbage and fry until brown.
Toss with the cooked pasta and serve with black pepper.

brokkolis-teszta.name: Creamy broccoli and bacon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and broccoli florets in the same pot of salted water (the broccoli for the last 4 minutes).
Fry the bacon and garlic, pour in the cream and stir in the grated cheese.
Toss the drained pasta and broccoli with the sauce.

tonhalas-teszta.name: Tuna and tomato penne
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in oil, pour in the passata and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and season.
Toss the cooked penne with the sauce.

sult-hal.name: Butter-fried fish fillet with pea rice
steps: Cook the rice together with the peas.
Season the thawed fish with salt, dust it with flour and fry it in butter for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve with the pea rice.

csicseri-curry.name: Chickpea curry with spinach
steps: Fry the onion and season it with curry powder.
Add the chickpeas, passata and coconut milk and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve with rice.

karaj-zoldseg.name: Tray-baked pork loin with vegetables
steps: Slice the pork loin and season it.
Cut the vegetables into large pieces, put them in a baking tray, drizzle with oil and lay the meat on top.
Bake covered at 200 °C for 40 minutes, then uncovered for another 20 minutes.

porkolt.name: Pork pörkölt with pasta and cucumber salad
steps: Sweat plenty of onion in fat until translucent, take it off the heat and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the diced meat, season with salt and caraway, and braise with a little water for 1.5 hours until tender. Add the pepper and tomato along the way.
Cook the pasta, slice the cucumber thinly and make a salad with vinegar-and-sugar water.

pizza-tortilla.name: Quick tortilla pizza
steps: Lay the tortillas on baking paper and spread them with seasoned passata.
Scatter over the sliced mushrooms, sweetcorn and torn mozzarella.
Bake at 220 °C for 8–10 minutes until crisp.

zabkasa.name: Apple and cinnamon porridge
steps: Bring the oats to the boil with the milk and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring.
Grate in one of the apples and season with cinnamon.
Top with sliced apple and banana.

rizi-bizi-csirke.name: Roast chicken legs with rice and peas
steps: Season the chicken legs and roast at 200 °C for about 45 minutes until crispy.
Cook the rice with the peas.
Serve together, drizzled with the roasting juices.

joghurtos-csirke.name: Chicken salad with garlic yoghurt
steps: Season the chicken breast, cook it in a griddle pan and cut it into strips.
Dice the vegetables.
Mix the yoghurt with crushed garlic, salt and dill, and toss everything together. Serve with toast.

gulyasleves.name: Goulash soup
steps: Sweat the onion in fat until translucent, take it off the heat and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the diced meat, season with caraway and crushed garlic, and braise it in its own juice for 1 hour.
Pour in 2 litres of water and add the sliced carrot, parsley root, pepper and tomato.
When the meat is almost tender, add the diced potatoes and cook everything until soft.

ujhazi.name: Újházi chicken soup
steps: Put the hen in cold water and simmer it very gently; skim off the foam.
After two hours add the cleaned vegetables, the onion and the spices.
When the meat comes off the bone, strain the soup and cook the thin noodles separately. Serve with the meat and vegetables.

halaszle.name: Fisherman's soup (halászlé)
steps: Finely chop the onion, cook it in 1.5 litres of water for 30 minutes, then press it through a sieve.
Add the salted fish pieces, the pepper, the tomato and plenty of paprika.
Boil hard for 20 minutes without stirring, just shaking the pot. Serve with fresh bread.

harcsapaprikas.name: Catfish paprikash with cottage cheese pasta
steps: Sauté the onion, sprinkle with paprika and add the pepper, tomato and a little water.
Lay in the salted catfish pieces and cook for 15 minutes without stirring.
Thicken with sour cream. Cook the pasta and serve it on the side with cottage cheese.

karfiolleves.name: Creamy cauliflower soup
steps: Cook the cauliflower florets and the sliced carrot and parsley root in 1.5 litres of salted water until tender.
Stir the sour cream smooth with the flour and a little cold water, then use it to thicken the soup.
Boil for another 3 minutes and season with nutmeg.

rantott-karfiol.name: Breaded cauliflower with parsley potatoes
steps: Parboil the cauliflower florets in salted water until just tender and let them cool.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry in plenty of oil until golden.
Boil the potatoes and toss them with butter and parsley. Mix the yoghurt with mustard and salt into a sauce.

kelkaposzta-fozelek.name: Savoy cabbage stew with fried sausage
steps: Cut the savoy cabbage into strips, dice the potatoes and cook them in a little salted water with caraway until tender.
Thicken with milk mixed with flour and crushed garlic and bring to the boil.
Fry the sausage in a pan and lay it on top of the stew.

repafozelek.name: Creamed carrots with fried eggs
steps: Sweat the sliced carrots in butter with a little sugar, then cook them until tender with a little water.
Thicken with milk mixed with flour and season with chopped parsley.
Serve with fried eggs.

krumplifozelek.name: Potato stew with frankfurters
steps: Cook the diced potatoes in salted water with a bay leaf until tender.
Sauté the onion in fat, make a roux with flour and paprika and add it to the potatoes.
Season with sour cream and a little vinegar. Serve with boiled frankfurters.

krumplileves.name: Potato soup with sausage
steps: Sauté the onion, sprinkle with paprika and pour in 1.5 litres of water.
Cook the diced potatoes, carrot, parsley root and sliced sausage in it.
When everything is soft, thicken with sour cream mixed with flour.

zoldborsoleves.name: Green pea soup
steps: Sweat the sliced carrot and parsley root in butter and add the peas.
Sprinkle with flour, pour in 1.5 litres of water and cook for 15 minutes.
Knead the egg with a little flour into a dough and pinch small pieces into the soup.

brassoi.name: Brassó-style pork with fried potatoes
steps: Cut the meat into strips, brown it with the onion in fat, then braise until tender with a little water.
Dice the potatoes and fry them in oil until crispy.
Stir the crushed garlic and marjoram into the meat, then toss with the potatoes. Serve with pickled gherkins.

rantott-hus.name: Breaded pork schnitzel with rice
steps: Slice the pork loin, pound it thin and season with salt.
Coat in flour, beaten egg and then breadcrumbs, and deep-fry in plenty of oil.
Serve with steamed rice and pickled gherkins.

sult-oldalas.name: Roast spare ribs with onion potatoes
steps: Salt the ribs, brush them with garlic mustard and roast covered with a little water at 160 °C for 1 hour.
Add the potato wedges and onion and roast uncovered at 200 °C for another 40 minutes until everything is crispy.

hagymas-tarja.name: Pork neck steak with crispy onions and chips
steps: Pound the pork neck slices, season them and fry them in a hot pan for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Coat the onion rings in flour and fry them in plenty of oil until crispy.
Cook the chips in the oven or in oil, and make a vinegar salad from the cucumber.

csirkeszarny.name: Crispy roast chicken wings with garlic yoghurt
steps: Toss the wings with oil and spices and put them in a baking tray next to the potato wedges.
Roast at 220 °C for about 40 minutes until crispy, turning them halfway.
Mix the yoghurt with crushed garlic and salt into a sauce.

sult-csirke.name: Whole roast chicken on a bed of vegetables
steps: Season the chicken inside and out, put a halved lemon in the cavity and rub the skin with soft butter.
Put large pieces of potato, carrot and onion in a baking tray and lay the chicken on top.
Roast at 200 °C for about 80 minutes, basting now and then with the juices.

pulykasalata.name: Grilled turkey breast salad
steps: Slice the turkey breast, season it and cook it through in a hot pan.
Chop the vegetables and mix them with the sweetcorn.
Mix the yoghurt with mustard and salt into a dressing and put it on the salad with the meat cut into strips. Serve with bread rolls.

rantott-sajt.name: Fried breaded cheese with chips
steps: Cut the cheese into 1 cm thick slices.
Coat twice in flour, egg and breadcrumbs so it doesn't leak while frying.
Fry quickly in plenty of hot oil. Serve with chips and a mustard-yoghurt sauce.

melegszendvics.name: Ham and cheese toasted sandwiches
steps: Butter the slices of bread thinly.
Top them with the ham, tomato slices and grated cheese.
Bake in a 200 °C oven for 6–8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

gorog-salata.name: Greek salad
steps: Cut the tomato, cucumber and pepper into chunks and the onion into thin rings.
Mix, season with salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil.
Top with the feta, whole or roughly crumbled, and sprinkle with oregano.

korozott.name: Körözött (paprika cheese spread) with fresh bread
steps: Mash the cottage cheese with the soft butter using a fork.
Mix in the very finely chopped onion, paprika, caraway and salt.
Serve with fresh bread and sliced pepper.

sajtos-teszta.name: Pasta with cheese and sour cream
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, drain it and toss it with the butter.
Stir in half of the sour cream; when serving, top with the rest of the sour cream and plenty of grated cheese.

almas-pite.name: Apple pie
steps: Rub the flour and cold butter together, add the icing sugar, egg, sour cream and baking powder and quickly knead into a dough. Chill for 30 minutes.
Grate the apples, squeeze them out and cook them with sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice.
Roll half of the dough into a baking tin, spread the filling on it, cover with the other half and prick with a fork.
Bake at 180 °C for about 35 minutes until golden brown.

tojasos-nokedli.name: Egg nokedli with cucumber salad
steps: Mix a dumpling batter from the flour, 3 eggs, salt and water and drop small pieces into boiling salted water.
Toss the cooked nokedli in oil, pour over the rest of the beaten eggs and stir until set.
Slice the cucumber thinly, put it in vinegar-and-sugar water and sprinkle with paprika.

rakott-karfiol.name: Cauliflower bake
steps: Cook the cauliflower florets in salted water until half-tender and cook the rice separately.
Brown the minced meat with the onion, season it and mix it with the rice.
Layer the cauliflower and meat in a baking dish and top with sour cream mixed with egg and grated cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for about 30 minutes until golden.

rizses-hus.name: Chicken and vegetable rice
steps: Sauté the onion, add the diced chicken and fry until it turns white.
Add the rice and diced carrot, stir, then pour in twice the rice's volume of water.
Cook covered for 18 minutes; stir in the peas and sweetcorn for the last 5 minutes.

gyumolcssalata.name: Fruit salad with yoghurt
steps: Wash and peel the fruit and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Drizzle with lemon juice so it doesn't go brown.
Serve with honey yoghurt.

kakaos-palacsinta.name: Cocoa crêpes
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, a pinch of salt and a little oil until smooth, and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Fry thin crêpes in a hot frying pan.
Mix the cocoa with the icing sugar, sprinkle it over the crêpes and roll them up.

kekszes-kremes.name: Biscuit and cream pots
steps: Whip the cream until stiff, mix the cottage cheese with the icing sugar, then gently fold the two together.
Layer the crumbled biscuits, the cream and the banana slices in glasses.
Dust the top with cocoa powder and chill until serving.

carbonara.name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water; set aside a mug of the cooking water.
Fry the diced bacon in a pan until the fat renders.
Mix the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Toss the drained pasta with the bacon, take it off the heat and stir in the egg and cheese with a little cooking water so it turns creamy, not scrambled.

smash-burger.name: Smash burgers with chips
steps: Cook the chips in the oven or air fryer according to the packet.
Shape 8 balls from the minced meat and press them thin with a flat utensil in a very hot pan; season with salt and pepper.
After 1.5 minutes flip them, put the cheese on top and cook for another minute.
Put two patties, onion, tomato, gherkin and sauce into each halved, toasted bun.

fajitas.name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and toss with the spices.
Cook through in a hot pan in a few minutes, then take it out.
In the same pan, fry the pepper and onion strips until crisp-tender and return the meat.
Serve with warm tortillas, sour cream and grated cheese; everyone rolls their own.

citromos-lazac.name: Lemon butter salmon with rice and broccoli
steps: Cook the rice in twice its volume of salted water until tender.
Steam the broccoli florets or boil them in salted water for 4 minutes.
Season the salmon with salt and pepper and fry it skin side down for 4 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side (or 10 minutes at 200 °C in an air fryer).
Froth the butter in the pan with the lemon juice and dill and spoon it over the fish.

lasagne.name: Lasagne Bolognese
steps: Sauté the onion and grated carrot, add the minced meat, then the passata, and cook for 20 minutes.
For the béchamel, melt the butter, stir in the flour, then the milk little by little, and cook until thick; season with salt and nutmeg.
Layer in a baking dish: ragù, lasagne sheet, béchamel – repeat three times and finish with cheese on top.
Bake in a 180 °C oven for about 40 minutes and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

csirkes-ramen.name: Chicken ramen with egg
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger, garlic and soy sauce for 15 minutes.
Poach the chicken breast in the stock for 12 minutes, take it out and slice it.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, put them in cold water, then peel and halve them.
Add the sliced mushrooms, carrot and noodles to the soup; serve in bowls with the chicken and egg.

csirkes-paella.name: Chicken and vegetable paella
steps: Brown the chicken legs all over in a wide pan, then take them out.
Soften the onion, garlic, pepper and grated tomato in the fat, add the spices and the rice.
Pour in the stock, return the meat and cook for 20 minutes without stirring.
Scatter over the peas for the last 5 minutes; serve with lemon wedges.

gombas-rizotto.name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Sweat the onion in half of the butter until translucent, add the sliced mushrooms and fry them in their own juice.
Add the rice and toast it for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, waiting each time until it is absorbed; about 18 minutes.
Finally stir in the remaining butter and the grated cheese and let it rest for 2 minutes.

souvlaki.name: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki
steps: Marinate the diced chicken with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and garlic for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and cook all over in a griddle pan or the oven.
For the tzatziki, mix the yoghurt with the grated, squeezed cucumber, garlic and salt.
Put the meat, tomato, onion and tzatziki into warm tortillas.

halas-taco.name: Crispy fish tacos
steps: Season the fish, fry it for 3 minutes on each side, then flake it with a fork.
Slice the cabbage thinly and squeeze it with lemon juice and salt.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon juice and chili into a dressing.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, sweetcorn and dressing.

tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt and half of the spices for 30 minutes, then sear it in a hot pan.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the remaining spices and the passata and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream and the chicken and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve with steamed rice.

chili-sin-carne.name: Chili sin carne (meat-free chili)
steps: Soften the onion and diced pepper and sprinkle over the spices.
Add the passata, the drained beans and sweetcorn and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice or bread; sour cream goes well with it too.

turogomboc.name: Cottage cheese dumplings
steps: Work the cottage cheese together with the eggs, flour, salt and lemon zest and chill for 30 minutes.
Toast the breadcrumbs in butter until golden.
With wet hands shape dumplings and cook them in gently salted, rapidly boiling water for 10 minutes.
Roll them in the breadcrumbs and serve with icing sugar and sour cream.

makos-teszta.name: Poppy seed pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water and drain it.
Toss it with butter, then sprinkle with the poppy seeds mixed with icing sugar.

dios-teszta.name: Walnut pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water and drain it.
Toss it with butter and sprinkle with the walnuts mixed with icing sugar.

krumplis-teszta.name: Potato pasta
steps: Sweat the onion in oil until translucent and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the diced potatoes, braise until tender with a little water and mash lightly with a fork.
Toss with the cooked pasta, season with pepper and serve with pickled gherkins.

bableves.name: Bean soup with sausage
steps: Sauté the onion, sprinkle with paprika and pour in 1.5 litres of water.
Cook the sliced vegetables, the bay leaf and the sausage in it.
When the vegetables are soft, add the drained beans and cook for another 10 minutes.
Thicken with sour cream mixed with flour and season with a little vinegar.

paradicsomleves.name: Tomato soup with alphabet pasta
steps: Toast the flour lightly in the butter, then pour in the passata and 500 ml of water.
Season with sugar, salt and basil and cook for 10 minutes.
Cook the pasta separately and add it to the soup.

gombaleves.name: Creamy mushroom soup
steps: Sauté the onion, add the sliced mushrooms and fry them.
Pour in 1.5 litres of water and cook the sliced carrot and parsley root in it.
Mix the sour cream with the flour, use it to thicken the soup and season with thyme.

gombas-csirkemell.name: Creamy mushroom chicken with rice
steps: Steam the rice.
Cut the chicken breast into strips and brown them all over in a hot pan.
Add the onion and mushrooms and braise for 8 minutes.
Bring to the boil with the sour cream, season and serve with the rice.

hortobagyi.name: Hortobágy-style stuffed pancakes
steps: Make crêpes from flour, milk and eggs.
Cook the chicken with the onion and pepper as a stew, then take out the meat and chop it finely.
Mix the chopped meat with a little of the sauce and sour cream, roll it up in the crêpes and fold in the ends.
Put them in a baking dish, pour over the sauce boiled with sour cream and bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes.

rakott-kaposzta.name: Layered cabbage bake
steps: Slice the cabbage thinly, salt it and braise it in a little fat until half-tender.
Brown the minced meat with the onion and season it; cook the rice until half-done and mix it into the meat.
Layer in a baking dish: cabbage, meat, sliced sausage, sour cream – with cabbage and sour cream on top.
Bake in a 180 °C oven covered for 40 minutes, then uncovered for another 20.

toltott-paprika.name: Stuffed peppers in tomato sauce
steps: Cut out the cores of the peppers.
Mix the minced meat with the raw rice, egg and spices and stuff the peppers.
Bring the passata to the boil with water, sugar and salt, lay in the peppers and cook over a low heat for 50 minutes.
Serve with potatoes boiled in salted water.

szekelykaposzta.name: Székely goulash (pork and sauerkraut stew)
steps: Soften the onion, sprinkle with paprika, add the diced meat and cook it as a stew.
When the meat is half-tender, add the thinly sliced cabbage and the caraway and braise together until soft.
Thicken with sour cream mixed with flour and serve with dill.

csirke-zoldsegagyon.name: Spiced chicken breast on a bed of vegetables
steps: Cut the potatoes and vegetables into large pieces and toss them with oil and spices.
Rub the chicken breast with the spices.
Roast the vegetables in a tray at 200 °C for 20 minutes, then put the meat on top and roast for another 20 minutes (in an air fryer at 190 °C in 2 batches).

airfryer-csirkecomb.name: Crispy chicken legs with chips
steps: Rub the chicken legs with the spices.
Cook in an air fryer at 190 °C for 25 minutes or in the oven at 200 °C for 40 minutes, turning them halfway.
Cook the chips according to the packet.
Serve with garlic yoghurt.

rantott-hal.name: Fried breaded fish with potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice them and mix them with the onion, sour cream and mustard into a salad.
Season the fish with salt and coat it in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry both sides until golden in plenty of hot oil.
Serve with lemon wedges and the salad.

lazacos-teszta.name: Creamy spinach and salmon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sear the diced salmon all over in a pan and take it out.
Thaw the spinach over the garlic, pour in the cream and season with lemon juice.
Return the fish and toss everything with the pasta.

tonhalsalata.name: Tuna salad with beans and sweetcorn
steps: Drain the beans and sweetcorn, and dice the onion and pepper.
Mix with the drained tuna and season with oil, vinegar and salt.
Serve with fresh bread.

bundas-kenyer.name: Hungarian eggy bread
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and salt.
Dip the slices of bread in it and fry both sides in hot oil until golden.
Rub with garlic and serve with tomatoes.

sonkas-omlett.name: Ham and cheese omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Fry the diced pepper in butter for a minute and pour in the eggs.
When the bottom has set, scatter ham and cheese over one half, fold the other half over and cook for another minute.

shakshuka.name: Shakshuka with feta
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and pepper and sprinkle over the spices.
Add the passata and cook for 10 minutes until thick.
Make hollows, crack in the eggs and cook covered for 6–8 minutes.
Serve with crumbled feta and fresh bread.

amerikai-palacsinta.name: Banana pancakes
steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder, sugar and salt, then add the milk, egg and melted butter.
Fry palm-sized pancakes in a little butter in a small pan; flip them when the top is bubbly.
Serve with sliced banana, strawberries and honey.

joghurtos-zab.name: Overnight oats with yoghurt and fruit
steps: Mix the oats with the yoghurt and a spoonful of honey and leave them in the fridge overnight.
In the morning layer them in glasses with sliced banana and strawberries.

rizsfelfujt.name: Baked rice pudding
steps: Cook the rice in the milk with a pinch of salt until thick and let it cool until lukewarm.
Stir in the butter, egg yolks, half of the sugar and the lemon zest, then gently fold in the egg whites whipped with the rest of the sugar.
Spread in a buttered baking dish and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve with jam.

turokrem.name: Fruity cottage cheese cream
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with the yoghurt, icing sugar and lemon zest until creamy.
Layer it in glasses with the sliced fruit.

kakaos-csiga.name: Puff pastry cocoa swirls
steps: Unroll the pastry, brush it with melted butter and sprinkle with the cocoa mixed with icing sugar.
Roll it up tightly, cut into 2 cm slices and lay them on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200 °C for 15–18 minutes until golden brown.

rakott-teszta.name: Baked ham pasta
steps: Cook the pasta until half-done.
Mix the sour cream with the eggs, salt and pepper and toss it with the pasta and the diced ham.
Spread in a baking dish, sprinkle with grated cheese and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

arrabbiata.name: Penne all'arrabbiata
steps: Fry the sliced garlic and chili in the olive oil for a minute.
Add the passata, season with salt and cook for 10 minutes.
Toss with the cooked penne and serve with grated cheese.

pestos-teszta.name: Pesto chicken pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Season the chicken strips and cook them through.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, the chicken and the diced tomato.

csirkes-wok.name: Chicken and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Steam the rice.
Fry the chicken strips in a very hot pan and take them out.
Stir-fry the vegetables until crisp-tender and return the meat.
Season with soy sauce, honey and ginger and thicken with a little cornflour water.

tofus-pad-thai.name: Tofu fried rice noodles (pad thai style)
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water according to the packet.
Fry the diced tofu until crispy and take it out.
Stir-fry the vegetables, push them aside and scramble the beaten egg next to them.
Add the noodles, tofu and sauce, toss together and serve with roughly chopped peanuts and lemon.

piritott-rizs.name: Egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool completely (yesterday's rice is best).
Fry the carrot and peas in a hot pan and add the diced ham.
Push aside, scramble the beaten egg, then add the rice and fry everything together with soy sauce.

csicseri-salata.name: Mediterranean chickpea salad
steps: Drain the chickpeas and dice the vegetables.
Mix with olive oil, lemon juice and spices.
Top with crumbled feta.

kuszkusz-salata.name: Couscous and vegetable salad
steps: Pour hot salted water over the couscous, leave it covered for 5 minutes, then fluff it up with a fork.
Add the finely chopped vegetables, the lemon juice and the oil.
Serve with feta and fresh herbs.

sutotokkremleves.name: Creamy pumpkin soup
steps: Sauté the onion, add the diced pumpkin and pour in 1 litre of water.
Cook until tender, then blend with a stick blender.
Season with cream, ginger and nutmeg; serve with toast.

brokkolikremleves.name: Cheesy cream of broccoli soup
steps: Soften the onion, add the broccoli and diced potato and pour in 1 litre of water.
Cook until tender, then purée.
Stir in the cream and grated cheese and season.

edesburgonya-csirke.name: Roast chicken legs with sweet potatoes
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and spices.
Rub the chicken legs with the spices.
Roast together at 200 °C for 40 minutes (in an air fryer at 190 °C, in two batches, 25 minutes).
Serve with garlic yoghurt.

muszaka.name: Aubergine and potato bake (moussaka)
steps: Slice the aubergine and potatoes, salt them, brush with oil and pre-bake them in the oven.
Cook the minced meat with passata, cinnamon and oregano into a thick ragù.
Make a béchamel from butter, flour and milk and stir in the egg.
Layer in a baking dish: potato, aubergine, ragù, with béchamel on top; bake at 180 °C for 45 minutes.

zoldbabfozelek.name: Green bean stew with fried eggs
steps: Cook the green beans in a little salted water until tender.
Thicken with sour cream mixed with flour and milk, and season with garlic, dill and a little vinegar.
Serve with fried eggs.

karfiolfasirt.name: Cauliflower patties with mashed potatoes
steps: Cook the cauliflower until tender, drain it and mash it with a fork.
Mix with the egg, grated cheese, soaked bread roll and spices; shape into patties.
Fry both sides in a little oil until golden.
Boil the potatoes and mash them with butter and warm milk.

fasirt-pure.name: Meat patties with mashed potatoes
steps: Knead the minced meat with the soaked and squeezed bread roll, egg, grated onion and spices.
Shape flat patties and fry them in oil for 4–5 minutes on each side.
Boil the potatoes and mash them with butter and warm milk.
Serve with pickled gherkins.

paprikas-krumpli.name: Paprika potatoes with sausage
steps: Sauté the onion in fat and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the diced potatoes, the pepper, tomato, sliced sausage and caraway.
Pour in just enough water to cover and cook until tender. Serve with pickled gherkins.

nuggets.name: Homemade chicken nuggets with chips
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and spray with a little oil.
Cook in an air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes or in the oven at 220 °C for 18 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with chips and garlic yoghurt.

babgulyas.name: Bean goulash
steps: Soften the onion, sprinkle with paprika, add the diced meat and braise it in its own juice for 1 hour.
Pour in 1.5 litres of water and add the vegetables and potatoes.
When everything is soft, stir in the drained beans and cook for another 10 minutes.

marhahusleves.name: Beef broth with thin noodles
steps: Put the meat in cold water and simmer very gently for 2 hours; skim off the foam.
Add the vegetables, onion and spices and cook for another 45 minutes.
Strain the broth and cook the noodles separately; serve with the meat and vegetables.

zoldsegleves.name: Spring vegetable soup
steps: Dice the vegetables and sweat them in butter for a few minutes.
Sprinkle with flour, pour in 1.5 litres of water and cook until tender.
Serve with chopped parsley.

pogacsa.name: Cheese scones (pogácsa)
steps: Rub the flour and butter together, add the yeast, sour cream, egg yolk, half of the cheese and the salt and knead into a dough.
Roll it out a finger thick, score the top, brush with egg and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Cut out rounds and bake at 200 °C for 18–20 minutes.

lekvaros-bukta.name: Jam-filled buns (bukta)
steps: Activate the yeast in the lukewarm, sweetened milk.
Knead into a soft dough with the flour, egg, melted butter and salt and let it double in size.
Roll it out, cut into squares, put jam in the middle of each, pinch them closed and line them up in a baking tray.
Let them rise for another 20 minutes, brush with egg and bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

turos-retes.name: Cottage cheese strudel with puff pastry
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with the egg yolk, icing sugar, lemon zest and sour cream.
Spread it on the pastry sheets and roll them up.
Brush with egg and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden brown.

almas-retes.name: Apple and walnut strudel
steps: Grate the apples, squeeze them out and mix them with the sugar, cinnamon and walnuts.
Spread on the pastry sheets, roll them up and prick the tops.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

bananos-kenyer.name: Walnut banana bread
steps: Mash the bananas with a fork and mix them with the melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Add the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cinnamon and walnuts and stir just until combined.
Bake in a lined loaf tin at 175 °C for about 55 minutes.

mezes-mustaros-csirke.name: Honey-mustard chicken legs with potatoes
steps: Mix the mustard with honey, garlic, salt and a little oil and brush it over the chicken legs.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onion into segments and put them in the tray next to the meat.
Roast at 200 °C for about 45 minutes (in an air fryer at 190 °C for 25 minutes).

cordon-bleu.name: Chicken cordon bleu with rice
steps: Cut a pocket into the chicken breasts, season with salt and fill with ham and cheese.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry over a medium heat in plenty of oil for 5–6 minutes on each side.
Serve with steamed rice.

karaj-gombamartas.name: Pork chops with mushroom sauce
steps: Pound the pork slices, season them and fry them in a hot pan for 3 minutes on each side, then take them out.
In the same pan soften the onion and mushrooms, pour in the cream and bring to the boil.
Return the meat and simmer in the sauce for 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

gyros-tal.name: Gyros plate
steps: Cut the pork neck into thin strips and marinate with the gyros spice for 30 minutes.
Fry in batches in a hot pan until crispy.
Mix tzatziki from the yoghurt with grated cucumber and garlic.
Serve with chips, salad and tzatziki.

pulykaragu.name: Creamy turkey ragout with rice
steps: Brown the diced turkey all over with the onion.
Add the mushrooms and peas and braise for 10 minutes.
Bring to the boil with cream and tarragon and serve with rice.

mexikoi-egytal.name: Mexican beef and rice one-pot
steps: Brown the minced meat and season it.
Add the rice, the passata and 600 ml of water and cook covered for 15 minutes.
Stir in the beans, sweetcorn and diced pepper and cook for another 5 minutes.

burrito.name: Bean and rice burritos
steps: Cook the rice; braise the beans with the spices and mash them lightly.
Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, sweetcorn, tomato, cheese and sour cream.
Roll up tightly and toast both sides in a dry pan.

quesadilla.name: Ham and cheese quesadillas
steps: Scatter grated cheese, ham, sweetcorn and pepper over half of each tortilla and fold over the other half.
Toast both sides in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream.

hazi-pizza.name: Homemade ham and mushroom pizza
steps: Knead the flour with yeast, salt, oil and 300 ml of lukewarm water into a smooth dough and let it rise for 1 hour.
Roll it out onto two baking trays and spread with seasoned passata.
Top with the ham, mushrooms, sweetcorn and mozzarella.
Bake in the hottest possible oven (250 °C) for 10–12 minutes.

margherita.name: Pizza Margherita
steps: Knead the flour with yeast, salt, oil and 300 ml of lukewarm water into a smooth dough and let it rise for 1 hour.
Roll it out thinly, spread with salted passata and top with torn mozzarella and tomato slices.
Bake at 250 °C for 10–12 minutes and serve with fresh basil.

langos.name: Lángos (fried flatbread) with cheese and sour cream
steps: Knead the boiled, mashed potatoes with the flour, the yeast activated in lukewarm milk and salt into a soft dough, and let it rise for 1 hour.
With oiled hands stretch out palm-sized rounds.
Fry both sides in plenty of hot oil until golden.
Brush with garlic water and serve with sour cream and grated cheese.

hot-dog.name: Homemade hot dogs
steps: Heat the frankfurters in hot water for 5 minutes.
Slit the buns and warm them in the oven until crispy.
Fill with the frankfurter, gherkin, onion and sauces.

frittata.name: Potato and sausage frittata
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly and cook them until tender in an ovenproof frying pan.
Add the sausage and pepper and pour over the seasoned beaten eggs.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake in a 180 °C oven for 12–15 minutes until set.

spenotos-pite.name: Spinach and feta pie
steps: Thaw the spinach with garlic and let its liquid evaporate.
Once cool, mix it with the crumbled feta, the eggs and the spices.
Fill a pastry-lined tin, fold the edges over and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

rakott-brokkoli.name: Broccoli and ham bake
steps: Cook the broccoli and sliced potatoes in salted water until half-tender.
Layer them in a baking dish with the diced ham.
Mix the sour cream with the eggs and spices, pour it over and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

sult-camembert.name: Baked camembert with jam and toast
steps: Score the tops of the camemberts and sprinkle with thyme.
Bake in an air fryer at 180 °C for 8 minutes or in the oven at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Serve with toast, jam and tomatoes.

rantott-parizsi.name: Fried breaded bologna with mashed potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash them with butter and warm milk.
Cut the bologna into 1 cm slices and nick the edges.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry in hot oil.

voroslencse-dal.name: Red lentil dal with coconut milk
steps: Soften the onion and garlic and sprinkle over the spices.
Add the lentils, passata, coconut milk and 500 ml of water and cook for 20 minutes until the lentils break down.
Serve with rice.

csirkes-kuszkusz.name: Chicken and vegetable couscous
steps: Pour hot salted water over the couscous and leave it to stand for 5 minutes.
Dice the chicken and vegetables, season and fry them.
Add the drained chickpeas and toss everything with the couscous.

hummusz-tal.name: Hummus plate with vegetables
steps: Blend the chickpeas with the lemon juice, oil, garlic and a little water until creamy.
Season with salt and cumin.
Serve with vegetable sticks and bread.

ceklas-tal.name: Roast beetroot and sweet potato with feta
steps: Dice the beetroot and sweet potato and toss with oil, salt and thyme.
Roast at 200 °C for 35–40 minutes.
Serve with crumbled feta, walnuts and a little honey.

sutotokos-rizotto.name: Pumpkin risotto
steps: Soften the onion in butter, add the diced pumpkin and the rice.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring constantly, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in butter and cheese until creamy.

lazac-edesburgonya.name: Salmon with roast sweet potatoes and broccoli
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges, season with oil and roast at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Add the broccoli and the seasoned salmon and roast for another 12 minutes (10 minutes at 190 °C in an air fryer).
Serve drizzled with lemon juice.

tonhalas-rakott.name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Cook the pasta until half-done.
Mix it with the tuna, sweetcorn and the egg and sour cream mixture.
Spread in a baking dish, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

rantott-ponty.name: Fried carp with parsley potatoes
steps: Salt the fish pieces and leave them for 15 minutes.
Coat in flour, egg and flour again, and fry in plenty of oil.
Boil the potatoes in salted water and toss them with butter and parsley.

stroganoff.name: Pork Stroganoff with rice
steps: Cut the meat into thin strips, sear quickly all over in a hot pan and take it out.
Soften the onion and mushrooms, add the mustard and the gherkin strips.
Bring to the boil with sour cream, return the meat and serve with rice.

tejszines-sonkas-teszta.name: Creamy ham and pea pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas to the water for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the diced ham, pour in the cream and bring to the boil.
Toss with the pasta and the grated cheese.

mac-and-cheese.name: Mac and cheese
steps: Cook the pasta.
Toast the flour in the butter, add the milk little by little and cook until thick.
Stir in the grated cheese and a little mustard, then the pasta.

rakott-burgonya-sajtos.name: Creamy cheese potato gratin
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer them in a buttered baking dish rubbed with garlic, seasoning each layer.
Pour over the cream, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 180 °C for about 50 minutes.

krumplisalata-virsli.name: Potato salad with frankfurters
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins and hard-boil the eggs, then slice them.
Boil or fry the frankfurters and slice them.
Mix everything with a dressing of yoghurt, mustard and vinegar.

csirkes-tesztasalata.name: Chicken pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta and peas and rinse them with cold water.
Cook the chicken breast and dice it.
Toss everything with the dill-mustard yoghurt and chill until serving.

paraszt-reggeli.name: Farmer's breakfast
steps: Fry the diced potatoes in a little fat until crispy.
Add the onion and sausage, then pour over the beaten eggs and scramble.
Serve with bread.

makos-guba.name: Poppy seed bread pudding (mákos guba)
steps: Slice the bread rolls and drizzle them with warm milk sweetened with sugar and vanilla.
Sprinkle each layer with poppy seeds mixed with icing sugar.
Dot with butter and bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes.

lebbencsleves.name: Lebbencs soup (pasta and potato soup)
steps: Fry the bacon and toast the pasta in its fat.
Add the onion, sprinkle with paprika and pour in 1.5 litres of water.
Cook the potatoes, pepper and tomato in it.

fokhagymakremleves.name: Cream of garlic soup with croutons
steps: Soften the garlic in butter, add the diced potatoes and pour in 1 litre of water.
Cook until tender, purée and stir in the cream until smooth.
Serve with cheesy croutons.

sutotokos-curry.name: Pumpkin chicken curry
steps: Soften the onion, add the curry powder and the diced chicken.
Add the diced pumpkin and the coconut milk and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

szezamos-csirke.name: Sesame honey chicken with rice
steps: Coat the diced chicken in flour and fry it in hot oil until crispy.
Bring the soy sauce to the boil with honey and garlic and toss the chicken in it.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with steamed rice and broccoli.

csirke-uborkasalata.name: Grilled chicken breast with creamy cucumber salad
steps: Season the chicken breast and cook it in a griddle pan for 5–6 minutes on each side.
Slice the cucumber thinly, salt it, squeeze it out and mix with sour cream, garlic and a little vinegar.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

kremes-spenotos-csirke.name: Creamy spinach chicken with rice
steps: Season the chicken breast, cook it through and take it out.
In the same pan thaw the spinach over the garlic and pour in the cream.
Return the meat, bring to the boil and serve with rice.

risi-bisi-sonkas.name: Rice and peas with ham (risi e bisi)
steps: Toss the rice in butter and cook it until tender in twice its volume of salted water.
Add the peas and diced ham for the last 5 minutes.
Serve with grated cheese and parsley.

caprese-csirke.name: Baked chicken with tomato and mozzarella
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges, season with oil and pre-roast at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken breasts, put them next to the potatoes and layer the tomato and mozzarella slices on top.
Roast for another 20 minutes (15 minutes at 190 °C in an air fryer).

csirkeporkolt.name: Chicken pörkölt with nokedli
steps: Sweat the onion in fat until translucent, take it off the heat and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the chicken, pepper and tomato, season with salt and braise with a little water for 40 minutes.
Make nokedli from flour, eggs and water. Serve with pickled gherkins.

marhaporkolt.name: Beef pörkölt with boiled potatoes
steps: Slowly sweat plenty of onion in fat until translucent and sprinkle with paprika.
Add the diced meat, season and braise with a little water for 2–2.5 hours until tender.
Boil the potatoes in salted water; serve with pickled gherkins.

tocsni.name: Potato pancakes with cheese and sour cream
steps: Grate the potatoes and squeeze them out.
Mix with the egg, flour, crushed garlic and spices.
Fry thin pancakes in hot oil.
Serve with sour cream and grated cheese.

zoldseges-tojasos-teszta.name: Vegetable and egg fried noodles
steps: Cook the pasta.
Stir-fry the vegetables and shredded cabbage in a hot pan.
Push aside, scramble the beaten egg, then add the pasta and soy sauce and fry everything together.

lencsefasirt.name: Lentil patties with yoghurt sauce
steps: Cook the lentils until tender, drain and mash them with a fork.
Mix with the grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs and spices; shape into patties.
Fry both sides in a little oil.
Serve with boiled potatoes and garlic yoghurt.

tejfoles-csirkecomb-tepsis.name: Tray-baked chicken legs in sour cream
steps: Slice the potatoes and put them in the bottom of a baking tray with the onion.
Lay the seasoned chicken legs on top.
Mix the sour cream with garlic, pour it into the tray and bake at 190 °C for 50 minutes.

csirkemell-rizs-zoldseg.name: Steamed chicken and vegetable bowl
steps: Steam the rice.
Steam the vegetables or cook them in a little salted water until crisp-tender.
Season the chicken breast, cook it in a griddle pan and slice it.

kolbaszos-babos-egytal.name: Sausage and bean one-pot
steps: Fry the onion, pepper and sliced sausage.
Add the beans and passata, season and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve with fresh bread.

parizsi-tojasrantotta.name: Scrambled eggs with bologna on toast
steps: Soften the onion in butter and add the diced bologna.
Pour over the beaten eggs and stir until creamy.
Serve with toast.

gyumolcsos-palacsinta-eper.name: Strawberry and cottage cheese crêpes
steps: Mix a crêpe batter from flour, milk and eggs and fry thin crêpes.
Mix the cottage cheese with icing sugar.
Fill the crêpes with the cottage cheese cream and sliced strawberries.

almas-zabos-morzsa.name: Apple and oat crumble
steps: Dice the apples, toss them with cinnamon and lemon juice and put them in a baking dish.
Rub the oats, flour, sugar and cold butter into crumbs and scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes until the top is golden brown.
